turns: In SH, compute calendar 1999 revenue by product category using SALES, TIMES and PRODUCTS.

Using the same year and category grouping, now return each category's percentage of the year's total revenue, rounded to 2 decimals and ordered by category. Return all categories. Display percentages with exactly two fractional digits.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT prod_category,TO_CHAR(ROUND(100*revenue/SUM(revenue) OVER(),2), 'FM999999999990.00') FROM (SELECT p.prod_category,SUM(s.amount_sold) revenue FROM SH.sales s JOIN SH.times t ON t.time_id=s.time_id JOIN SH.products p ON p.prod_id=s.prod_id WHERE t.calendar_year=1999 GROUP BY p.prod_category) ORDER BY prod_category
